items.whatSheDid: Mentoring students from Barnier, Hambledon, Nirimba Fields and Quakers Hill Public Schools through the 2026 Primary Prosperitas program — helping them shape a personal interest project, work out their own driving question, and set goals for it.
items.whoItHelped: Younger primary students working through a big project of their own for the first time.

images.alt: Rithu sitting across a table from a primary school mentee, going through a worksheet together in the library

items.whatSheDid: Providing one-on-one support to students who want extra help getting ahead in their schoolwork.
items.whoItHelped: Students looking for support outside of regular class time.

items.whatSheDid: Helping bring students' suggestions to the school and contributing to changes that affect everyone, including through Mini Vinnies. Being part of the SRC has also meant a full Leadership Day of workshops on public speaking, critical thinking and problem-solving, alongside smaller team moments like the SRC's Valentine's Day rose deliveries around the school.
items.whoItHelped: Fellow students, by giving them a voice in decisions that affect the school.

images.alt: Rithu wearing her Student Representative Council badge, listening alongside fellow SRC members during a Leadership Day workshop

items.whatSheDid: Helping students find books, running library activities, and writing book reviews for the library's own review series, The Library Lowdown.
items.whoItHelped: Students looking for their next read.
items.whatChanged: Recognised in the school's 2025 Library Crew celebration and awarded a Certificate of School Service for her contribution as a Library Monitor, now in her second year in the role.

images.alt: Rithu holding her 2025 Certificate of School Service, awarded for being a QHHS Library Monitor

items.role: Devised & Ran the Book Blurb Challenge
items.whatSheDid: Came up with a book-blurb matching competition, then organised and ran it for the whole school — three fast-paced rounds where teams raced to match book covers to their blurbs.
items.whoItHelped: Turned an ordinary lunchtime into a genuinely competitive event for the school's book-loving crowd.
items.whatChanged: It came right down to the final round, with a block of Cadbury chocolate on the line.

images.alt: Rithu holding up a book beside a sign reading 'The Blurb Challenge', with a teammate holding a block of Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate

items.whatSheDid: Put together and hosted a music trivia challenge for the whole school during Multicultural Week — choosing the songs, building the slides, and running the competition from the front of the room with a microphone.
items.whoItHelped: Gave students a shared lunchtime activity, and a lighthearted way into music and culture beyond their own.
items.whatChanged: Turned an ordinary lunch break into a packed, competitive celebration of music from around the world.

images.alt: Rithu smiling and holding a microphone while hosting the International Music Trivia Challenge

items.whatSheDid: Encouraged other students to be more responsible, and helped contribute to a better school environment day to day.
